what: Inside a Section as tall as the number of slots × the screen height, the stage stays pinned to the screen. The scrolled ratio is divided by the slot count, and only the current slot is cross-faded on with .6s ease-in-out. Each time a slot turns on, its video restarts from 0s (slots that turn off pause and rewind to 0s). The title words fade in from 0 with .4s power1.out, staggered across .8s for the whole title. The progress bar below fills by the scrolled ratio and the number changes to 01, 02…

options.words: Time for all title words to light up (seconds), default .8 — without SplitText the whole title lights at once
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Cells (stacked) — the video inside starts from 0s when it turns on. When turned on it fires an fx:step event (detail.index) — canvas drawings receive it and redraw from the start
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title inside cell (turns on with a word)

use:
Cell 1 Title

note: The part sets the section height as the number of cells × 100dvh (original 500dvh · stage top 1.5rem). Cell changes are triggered by a threshold, not scrub, so scrolling back turns on the same cell at the same position
